title: Getting Started with QuickDash
content:
QuickDash is a floating overlay utility suite for Android. Once installed and granted the necessary permissions, a small floating button appears on your screen. Tap it to expand the toolbar and access all 12 tools.

To get started:
1. Download QuickDash from GitHub Releases, Play Store, or F-Droid
2. Grant overlay permission when prompted
3. Grant notification access for the quick settings tile
4. Tap the floating button to expand the toolbar
5. Customize your tools in Settings

title: Required Permissions
content:
QuickDash requires the following permissions to function:

- SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW: Required to draw the floating toolbar overlay on top of other apps
- NOTIFICATION_LISTENER: Required for the quick settings tile integration
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS: Required for Android 13+ to show update notifications
- CAMERA: Required for QR code scanning

All permissions are used exclusively for on-device functionality. No data is ever sent to any server.

title: Using the Floating Toolbar
content:
The floating toolbar is QuickDash's main interface. It appears as a small circular button on your screen that you can drag to any position.

Tap the button to expand it into a horizontal bar showing your enabled tools. Long-press and drag to move the toolbar. The toolbar automatically hides when not in use and reappears when you tap the floating button.

You can customize which tools appear in the toolbar and their order from the Settings screen.

title: Tools Overview
content:
QuickDash includes 12 essential tools:

1. UPI QR Generator — Generate payment QR codes for any UPI ID
2. Floating Translator — Select and translate text from any app
3. Quick Notes — Take notes with Markdown support
4. Calculator — Full-featured floating calculator with history
5. Wi-Fi QR — Share Wi-Fi credentials as QR codes
6. QR Scanner — Scan QR codes using your camera
7. Clipboard Manager — Search and manage clipboard history
8. Screen Dimmer — Adjust screen brightness from overlay
9. Unit Converter — Convert between any units
10. Text Extractor — Extract text from images via OCR
11. Color Picker — Pick colors from the screen
12. Quick Settings — Toggle system settings

title: Updates & Release Channels
content:
QuickDash offers multiple update channels:

GitHub Releases: Latest stable APKs with full changelog. Recommended for most users.

Play Store Beta: Gradual rollout via Google Play's beta program. Requires opt-in.

F-Droid: Open source release following F-Droid's verification process. May lag behind GitHub releases.

In-app update notifications will alert you when a new version is available.
